prefill: Require lower median paired candidate/baseline latency and improvement in at least four of five pairs. Report all per-pair ratios and dispersion.
decode: Report paired throughput/first-step distributions; do not accept a clear material decode regression masked by prefill improvement.
failures: Stop on failure; preserve all attempts; no retries to obtain favorable results.
profile: Separate diagnostic run after timed block. Raw invalid-counter values must be preserved, not accepted as valid timing.
claim_scope: 32K/128 Rust-to-Rust development improvement; no updated Rust-versus-DwarfStar throughput claim.
